title: Latvia digs anti-tank trenches, installs dragon’s teeth along its border with Russia
summary: Construction of the Baltic Defense Line is continuing along Latvia's eastern border with Russia. The fortifications are designed to impede the movement of potential enemy military equipment and include anti-tank trenches and concrete "dragon's teeth" obstacles.

title: German government explains conditions under which Merz willing to speak with Putin
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz is generally willing to hold talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin. However, such contact must have a specific purpose, while Berlin still sees no willingness on Russia's part to achieve a just and lasting peace in Ukraine.

title: Nine foreigners suspected of trying to join Russia's war against Ukraine arrested in South Africa
summary: Nine foreigners have been arrested in South Africa after they were caught allegedly trying to leave the country to fight in the war between Russia and the Ukraine.

title: Russian troops use recruited Africans as human shields in kill zone – intelligence
summary: Servicemen of the 39th Motor Rifle Brigade of the Russian Armed Forces are using recruited Africans as human shields while moving through the kill zone.

title: DIU examines new Russian Geran-5 K5-K drone: Nearly 100 foreign components, most of them American
summary: The Defense Intelligence of Ukraine (DIU) has published information on the components of a new Russian Geran-5 K5-K unmanned aerial vehicle.

title: Trump hopes to meet Xi and Putin at APEC summit in China
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said he expects to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin at next week's APEC summit in China, where he plans to discuss, among other issues, ending the war in Iran and denuclearization.
